attribution.creator: Brazilian Network Information Center (NIC.br), Cetic.br
attribution.citation: Brazilian Network Information Center. (2026). Survey on the use of information and communication technologies in Brazilian enterprises: ICT Enterprises 2025 [Tables]
attribution.modification_notice: This evidence catalog and its measurement note are derived analysis. Source numeric values, unit labels and cited wording remain unchanged; selection, alignment, formatting descriptions and interpretive caveats have been added.

coverage.independence_warning: Repeated statistical views, subgroup cells, languages and file formats are not independent samples or independent training observations. The aggregate estimates are correlated.

measurement_definition.title: H9 - ENTERPRISES THAT USED ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGIES
measurement_definition.screening_footnote: ¹This indicator was collected only among enterprises with IT specialists, area or department. For dissemination purposes, the results are presented by the total number of enterprises.
measurement_definition.survey_collection_population: Only enterprises with IT specialists, an IT area or department, as stated in the footnote.
measurement_definition.dissemination_population: Total enterprises in the survey universe, as stated in the table; not an unqualified claim about every Brazilian business.
measurement_definition.technology_scope: Artificial-intelligence technologies broadly; not a separately identified generative-AI or ChatGPT rate.

uncertainty_and_precision.percentage_margin_interpretation: Absolute percentage-scale margin (percentage points); the total-row count-margin/enterprise-total reconciliation supports this reading. No relative margin is used.
uncertainty_and_precision.confidence_level_status: Not stated in these workbook text cells.
uncertainty_and_precision.format_note: Percentage and percentage-margin cells use custom number format code 0. Stored decimal digits are retained for reproducibility; visible values round to whole numbers and the extra digits do not establish statistical precision.
uncertainty_and_precision.count_note: The Total view provides published enterprise totals, not unweighted respondent counts. Rounded component totals may not add exactly.
uncertainty_and_precision.missing_value_note: Literal hyphens are preserved as publisher markers, not changed to zero; their formal meaning is not specified in the table text.

adoption_evidence.row_category: Wholesale and retail trade, repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles
Real estate activities, professional, scientific and technical activities, administrative and support service activities
Arts, entertainment and recreation, other service activities

conditional_comparison.published_denominator: Total number of enterprises that used Artificial Intelligence technologies
conditional_comparison.warning: These category shares describe AI users and are not population-wide adoption rates. They sum to more than 100 and must not be treated as a partition.

evidence.technology_type: Text mining and written language analysis
Speech recognition, which converts spoken language into a machine-readable format
Natural language generation (NLG) for written or spoken language
Recognition and processing of images that identify objects or people
Machine learning, such as deep learning, for data prediction and analysis
Physical movement of machines through autonomous decisions, such as autonomous robots, vehicles, and drones

analysis_limits: Keep the H9 IT-screening footnote with the headline and every cross-survey comparison.
Do not infer trends, causal effects, subgroup significance or a 95% confidence interval from these aggregate tables.
Do not multiply H9A shares by H9 without checking aligned definitions, population, weighting and the variance/covariance needed for derived uncertainty.
The 17 H9 rows are one total, three size categories, five regions and eight market segments from the same survey. They are correlated aggregates, not 17 independent surveys.
The additional H9B/H9C/H10 measures are conditional on AI users, and H13 barriers are conditional on non-users.
